title: Vandermonde row indexing equivalence
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $\ell$, there is an equivalence between $\mathrm{Fin}((k-1)\ell+1)$ and the disjoint union of a singleton with $\mathrm{Fin}(k-1)\times\mathrm{Fin}(\ell)$.
